target: Wire a deterministic Command Palette broker primitive to the Cockpit runtime contract while preserving broker-only behavior, fail-closed routing, no execution, and Claude Design blockers.

commit.message: feat(cockpit): wire command palette broker primitive

pr.title: feat(cockpit): wire command palette broker primitive
pr.body:
## Summary
- add a pure Command Palette row normalizer and deterministic broker router to the Cockpit runtime contract
- route palette rows by activation, authority, safety class, parameters, placement, coverage, and allowed outcomes without executing commands
- add focused tests proving broker-only behavior, fail-closed UNKNOWN/BLOCKED handling, Settings/Admin routing, Safe Action Gate handoff, and search-axis coverage

## Strict scope
- no final screens
- no Claude Design upload
- no runtime action execution
- no T4 remote mutation
- no live service adapters
- no canonical writes
- no safe_for_claude_design flip

## Governance state
safe_for_claude_design: NO
READY_FOR_CLAUDE_DESIGN: not approved

## Validation
See proof bundle for command outputs and exit codes.

steps.task: Inspect AGENTS.md, the Cockpit handoff, D3/D4, the task plan, doctrine package, command-palette artifacts, current runtime contract code, tests, and package proofs before implementation.
validation: Integration branch and dedicated worktree are verified.
Command Palette artifact proof is identified as primitive-level and not runtime wiring.
Runtime code and tests are inspected before editing.

steps.task: Add failing tests for a pure Command Palette broker primitive covering search axes, row normalization, deterministic row hashes, Safe Action Gate routing, Settings/Admin routing, and fail-closed blocked/unknown/external rows.
validation: Focused tests fail before production code exists.
Tests assert broker_only true and executes false.
Tests assert no blocked, unknown, external, unresolved-parameter, or unknown-authority row can open the Safe Action Gate.

steps.task: Implement the minimal deterministic Command Palette broker primitive in runtime_contract.py without execution side effects.
validation: Rows normalize missing fields to literal UNKNOWN.
Routing applies the accepted rule order and resolves exactly one outcome.
The primitive produces no shellout, network, service, PM, ConPort, dope-memory, or canonical-write behavior.

steps.task: Validate the packet, inspect diff scope, run codereview/precommit checks, commit, push, and open a PR to the integration branch.
validation: Task packet JSON parses and conforms to the canonical schema.
Focused Cockpit tests, cockpit test directory, brand_lint, sync_brand_tokens, and git diff checks pass or exact blockers are recorded.
Only allowlisted files are staged and committed.
